Inside Macintosh: Mac OS 8 Human Interface Guidelines /

Chapter 4 - Menu Guidelines

This chapter describes the menu changes introduced by Mac OS 8, including menu bar appearance, help menus, sticky menus, contextual menus, and the enhancement of keyboard equivalents for menu item selection.

For more complete information on designing and using menus, see "Menus" in Macintosh Human Interface Guidelines.
